author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Loaded hand truck at the left (upright frame with an angled grip, parcel on the toe plate, wheel below) beside a worker bust at the right (capped head resting on a shoulder dome over a tapered body), as in the reference; the current drawing replaced the worker bust with a walking stick figure and hung the wheel off a pole, so neither part matched.
omissions: The reference's cap brim line across the head is drawn as a visor stub (a line through the head would leave two undersized half-disc holes); the frame is upright rather than slanted so the parcel can rest against it.
